scope: Independent question-content review of all eight Cambridge 18 and 19 Reading tests against the supplied local source scans. Covers all question statements, instructions, numbering, native choices, word limits and the full visible completion/summary layouts. Reading-passage fidelity is reviewed separately by the library-preparation agent; answer-key provenance is recorded in keys-report.json. This local editorial review is not publisher certification.
method: Visually opened all 55 original question pages rendered from the source PDFs at readable resolution, compared each native question and choice with the scan, and separately opened every one of the 23 retained source-mode question crops to confirm the complete tables, notes, summaries, options and numbered blanks are present. Reread the final native question strings after applying the corrections.
readingPreservation: The correction script snapshots every passage field except groups and asserts exact equality after all question changes. No source PDF or image asset is altered or deleted. Corrected full test files are also saved as preparation overrides.

displayPreparation: Native matching bodies are reconstructed from the reviewed numbered questions and correct option labels, preventing old OCR debris or swallowed questions from being displayed.
Native MCQ and TFNG/YN/NG groups use the reviewed individual question text. Choose-TWO groups display one reviewed prompt and the native choice list.

Source-mode completion and summary groups retain faithful local images and native answer controls. Hidden OCR body text is not asserted to be a word-perfect transcription; it is not used for the visible task layout.
